storeListingCopy.fullDescription:
SERP AlphaPorno Downloader makes it easy to save videos from AlphaPorno.com to your computer.

How it works: Go to any video page on AlphaPorno, press play, and either click the in-page download button or the extension icon in your toolbar. The extension detects the video stream, shows you available quality options, and downloads it as a standard MP4 file.

It handles HLS streaming and CDN restrictions automatically — no external tools, no command line, no technical knowledge required. Videos are saved directly to your Downloads folder in an organized AlphaPorno subfolder.

Key features:
- Automatic video detection when you play a video on AlphaPorno
- In-page download button right on the video player — no popup needed
- Converts HLS streams to standard MP4 files in your browser
- Quality selection (360p, 480p, 720p, 1080p depending on source)
- Real-time download progress with speed and size indicators
- Right-click context menu for quick downloads
- Dark-themed UI with crimson red accents
- 3 free downloads to try before you buy

Getting started:
1. Install the extension
2. Go to AlphaPorno.com and play a video
3. Click the download button on the player or the extension icon
4. Select quality and download — saved as MP4

Sign in with your email to unlock 3 free trial downloads. Upgrade to a license for unlimited downloads.

Supports Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera, Firefox, and more.

faq.question: How do I download a video?
faq.answer: Go to any video page on AlphaPorno.com and press play. Then either click the download button that appears on the player, or click the extension icon in your toolbar. Select your preferred quality and hit download.

faq.question: What quality options are available?
faq.answer: The extension offers whatever qualities the source video provides — typically 360p, 480p, 720p, and sometimes 1080p. It auto-detects available resolutions.

faq.question: What format are downloaded videos?
faq.answer: All videos are saved as standard MP4 files that play on any device or media player.

faq.question: Where are my downloads saved?
faq.answer: Videos are automatically saved to a AlphaPorno subfolder inside your browser's default Downloads directory.

faq.question: How many free downloads do I get?
faq.answer: You get 3 free trial downloads after signing in with your email. After that, purchase a license for unlimited downloads.

faq.question: Does this work on Firefox?
faq.answer: Yes — supports Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera, Whale, Yandex, and Firefox.

faq.question: Why isn't the extension finding my video?
faq.answer: Make sure you've pressed play on the video first. The extension needs the stream to start before it can detect it. If issues persist, try refreshing the page.

faq.question: Is my data safe?
faq.answer: Yes. Video processing happens entirely in your browser — nothing is uploaded. Authentication uses secure OTP (one-time password) — no passwords stored.
